title: Reduced generic tensor algebra of a DVR root extension
statement: Let $B$ be a DVR domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], $\pi\in B$ irreducible and $n>0$. Let $K=\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ and let $E/K$ be a finite Galois field extension [def-weil-field, def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Give $E$ its composite $B$-algebra structure through $K$ and set $A=B[t]/(t^n-\pi)$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Then $E\otimes_B A$ is reduced, meaning its only nilpotent element is zero. No invertibility assumption on $n$ is imposed.

proof.text: The polynomial is Eisenstein at (pi): monicity excludes its leading coefficient from the proper prime ideal, the lower coefficients belong to (pi), and -pi does not belong to (pi)^2 because pow_dvd_pow_iff for the nonzero nonunit pi excludes pi^2 dividing pi. Eisenstein irreducibility and the UFD structure of B[X] make the polynomial prime. Thus A is a domain and the positive-degree quotient embeds B in A.

Set L=Frac(A). Its faithful B-algebra structure lifts to K and forms a scalar tower. E is B-flat by flatness of the localization K/B and of the vector space E/K. Tensoring A -> L with E gives an injection E tensor_B A -> E tensor_B L. Localization base change identifies the latter with E tensor_K L.

Galois separability gives formal unramifiedness of E/K. Its finite dimension gives essential finite type. These properties survive base change to L, so L tensor_K E is reduced by Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field. Commute the tensor factors and descend reducedness along the injection. All these steps are implemented in the new Lean module without sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_galois_root_tensor_reduced
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ IsGalois (FractionRing B) E) :
    let : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp
        (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    IsReduced (E ⊗[B]
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi))
